pain_points.statement: Finance is significantly delayed on invoicing due to data discrepancies.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: The company wants to return to an industry-standard Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
desired_state.source_excerpt: a return to five-day DSO from where we are now

desired_state.statement: The CFO requires a fixed-fee engagement with milestone-based payments.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: Free up $1.4M in working capital currently trapped in unbilled receivables.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: frees up about $1.4M in working capital that's currently stuck in unbilled receivables.

success_criteria.statement: Avoid $320k in future headcount costs by not hiring additional dispatchers.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k

risks_unknowns.statement: Stakeholders disagree on the approved budget for the Phase 1 engagement.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita insists on a strict $300k cap, while Sarah claims they previously discussed a $250k-$400k range.

pain_points.statement: The custom dispatch tool, Routemaster, has severe technical debt preventing new feature development.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Technical debt in Routemaster. We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

pain_points.statement: The custom React Native mobile app is strongly disliked by the drivers.

desired_state.statement: There is disagreement on whether to replace the dispatch platform entirely or fix workflows incrementally.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem.
desired_state.contradiction_note: Marcus wants to replace Routemaster with a SaaS platform, while Sarah wants to patch the existing workflows.

desired_state.statement: Workflow logic should be built as a portable layer on top of Routemaster.
desired_state.source_excerpt: workflow logic in a layer on top of Routemaster... most of the workflow logic is portable.

success_criteria.statement: The CTO must review and approve the proposed architecture.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I want to be in the room when you walk through the architecture.

success_criteria.statement: A majority of the Phase 1 work must survive a potential future platform change.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Previous internal attempts to fix the workflow issues have failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

risks_unknowns.statement: Any changes to the driver app will overlap with upcoming ELD compliance work.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: If we're going to touch the driver app, the ELD work has to be coordinated.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers suffer from excessive manual double-entry between systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

desired_state.statement: The initial focus should be on fixing invoicing reconciliation, followed by the dispatcher workflow.
desired_state.source_excerpt: focus on the invoicing reconciliation first... and then the dispatcher workflow

success_criteria.statement: Achieve a 30% reduction in the time it takes to dispatch each load.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

risks_unknowns.statement: Stakeholders disagree on the feasibility of the Q3 pilot deadline.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita and Sarah require a Q3 pilot for budget reasons, but Marcus believes Q4 is more realistic.

pain_points.statement: Technical integration from recent acquisitions remains incomplete.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Any new solutions must not interfere with the upcoming ELD compliance mandate.
desired_state.source_excerpt: whatever we build needs to not get in the way of the compliance work.

success_criteria.statement: Meet the November 15th ELD deadline to avoid fines and loss of operating authority.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.

risks_unknowns.statement: Making a multi-year platform decision under a short-term deadline is seen as a major risk.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We should not be making a multi-year platform decision under an artificial six-month deadline.

risks_unknowns.statement: The consulting team lacks details on the ELD compliance requirements.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: I need to learn more about the ELD work before I can speak to that.
